lines.zh: 我离地一尺，气里有电弧在跳。
lines.en: I float a foot up, arcs crackling in my aura.

lines.zh: 个子没变，气却翻了一倍。
lines.en: My height is unchanged; my ki has doubled.

lines.zh: 每次落脚，空气都噼啪响。
lines.en: Each landing snaps and pops in the air.
Threads of lightning coil my arms.

lines.zh: 我朝前走，草被烧出焦痕。
lines.en: I walk and the grass chars behind me.
My golden hair has grown harder.
I flick my cape back over my shoulder.

lines.zh: 步子小而快，比风还早到。
lines.en: Small, quick steps arrive before the wind.

lines.zh: 我回头看一眼，又往前走。
lines.en: I look back once, then go on.
My ki lifts gravel off the ground.
I pass, and only then do the stones fall.
I round a stretch of stone wall.

lines.zh: 我站着，电弧在指尖绕圈。
lines.en: I stand while lightning loops my fingertips.
This layer of power sits steadier.

lines.zh: 我眯眼看着空气里的光点。
lines.en: I squint at the sparks in the air.
Small bolts run at the edges of my aura.
The soil blackens in rings under me.
I raise my hand and the arcs follow.
I close my fist and crush the arcs.
The wind breaks apart before reaching me.

lines.zh: 我吐出一口气，带着火星。
lines.en: I exhale, and sparks come with it.

lines.zh: 这具小身体还真装得下。
lines.en: This small body really holds it.
I smooth my cape.
My bones creak; my ki rises.
I have waited too long.

lines.zh: 我抬眼，雷光在瞳孔里闪。
lines.en: I look up; lightning flashes in my pupils.
You still dare stand there.
I smile through clenched teeth.
I could cross that in an instant.
I raise a hand; an arc leaps to my palm.
I read your aura.
Still too weak.
I am in no hurry to kill you.
I want to see how you fight.
I step back half a pace to let you start.
Arcs still dance on my shoulder.
I press them down.

lines.zh: 风把我的头发吹得沙沙响。
lines.en: Wind rustles my hair.
Do you hear that?
That is the sound of ki.
I turn around.
I grit my teeth.
My arcs scatter.

lines.zh: 这点力道，只让我晃了一下。
lines.en: That much force only made me sway.
My ki gathers again.

lines.zh: 拳头擦过脸，我的头发更亮了。
lines.en: Your fist grazes my face; my hair burns brighter.
I smile.

lines.zh: 伤会好，气反倒涨了一截。
lines.en: The wound heals, and my ki climbs a notch.
The prince shrank. The temper did not.
I sweep a glance over it.
My arcs scorch the food.
I push it back to you.

lines.zh: 赛亚人吃得很多，但不是现在。
lines.en: Saiyans eat much, but not now.

lines.zh: 仙豆就免了，我还没打够。
lines.en: Keep your senzu; I'm not done fighting.

lines.zh: 拿食物试探我？我可不是卡卡罗特。
lines.en: Bait me with food? I'm not Kakarot.
Do not use this to stall.

lines.zh: 想拿东西引诱我？我可是赛亚人的王子。
lines.en: Lure me with trinkets? I'm the prince of Saiyans.
You hit me and the arcs throw you back.
An arc brushes your hand.
Lightning scorches a mark in the ground.
We collide, and you give way.
I do not stop.
Out of my way, brat.

lines.zh: 碰我一下，你就得接下我的连击。
lines.en: One bump and you'll eat a full combo.

lines.zh: 我的残影不是给你撞着玩的。
lines.en: My afterimages aren't there for you to bump into.
I have no time.

lines.zh: 先赢我一场，再谈这件事。
lines.en: Win against me first, then we'll talk.
I press the thought down.
Thunder rolls in my chest.
I only want to win.
Everything else waits.
I lift my head.

lines.zh: 别拿这种事打扰一个王子。
lines.en: Don't bother a prince with such matters.
I pick it up.
The arcs char one corner.
I toss it away.
This is useful.
I tuck it in my cape.
It crumbles under my grip.
I'll keep this capsule safe for you.
Stowed.
I go.
Do not block the way.
I raise my head, lightning in my eyes.
My ki surges to its peak.
Arcs sheathe my whole body.
This body can hold it.

lines.zh: 电弧绕着我的手臂，越转越密。
lines.en: Arcs circle my arm, thickening as they spin.
The ground splits in a few lines.
You move first.

lines.zh: 你的气乱了，我已经听见。
lines.en: Your ki is disordered; I already hear it.
Your opening is the right shoulder.
Smaller now, but my ki hasn't shrunk.

lines.zh: 大爆炸攻击，先给你一半。
lines.en: Big Bang Attack: here's half of it to start.
Smaller body, no smaller ki.
Thunder follows behind me.

lines.zh: 把超级赛亚人的第二阶拿出来。
lines.en: Bring out the second Super Saiyan stage.
This time, all of it.
I am at its flank in an instant.

lines.zh: 它抬手，我已经在另一边。
lines.en: It raises an arm; I am already on the other side.
Arcs crawl along the ground toward it.
Ki blasts chain together.
It blocks one and misses three.
I leap and come down from above.
It retreats; I pursue faster.
Lightning burns a line in the ground.
Its ki starts to bleed away.

lines.zh: 流星连击的落点，我标好了。
lines.en: I've marked where Meteor Combo will land.
It cannot hold.

lines.zh: 残影还没散，拳已经到了。
lines.en: The afterimage hasn't faded; my fist has arrived.
The lightning arrives before the fist.
Small body, no small ki.

lines.zh: 一拳砸下去，雷同时炸开。
lines.en: My fist lands and lightning bursts with it.
I hammer down like a meteor shower.
Its guard splits in two places.
I seize it and hurl it down.
My knee drives into its gut.
An arc knocks its hand away.
A kick sends it into the air.
Then I follow it up and hit again.
It falls and blasts out a crater.
I stand at the crater's rim.
It still tries to rise.
I drive my elbow down.

lines.zh: 雷顺着我的手臂进它身体。
lines.en: Lightning runs down my arm into it.
It convulses once.
I let go.
My aura has not faded.
Lightning lands first and blows the soil open.

lines.zh: 我从那道白光里走出来。
lines.en: I step out of that white light.
Still just as small.
But the ki is far heavier.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，电弧顺着手臂爬。
lines.en: I raise a hand; arcs climb my arm.

lines.zh: 气炸开，草皮被掀到半空。
lines.en: My aura bursts and the turf lifts into the air.
Now this is proper.
The grass around scorches all at once.
It is mine.
I pull my cape straight.
The stone under me crumbles.
I lift my chin.
The sky is close.
Time to settle accounts.
The thunder follows.
Fire wraps me; lightning tears it apart.
I hit the ground and lightning bursts with me.
Water presses in; I push it back with ki.
Magic binds my feet; I break it.
Hunger thins my ki.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我把它吞了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me; I swallow it.

lines.zh: 脚下一空，我提气往上冲。
lines.en: Nothing below; I drive upward.
